summary: Phase 47 (Guardian Eye multi-model + Compass GPS bearing) + Phase 48 (Cognitive Triage / Crisis HUD) — 27/27 backend tests PASSED (100%) in 36.6s against the live preview backend (https://guardian-vault-13.preview.emergentagent.com). All three vision providers actually resolved (no graceful-degrade path hit): openai/gpt-5.4, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 and gemini/gemini-3.1-pro-preview all returned kind='medication' + name='Paralen 500 mg' + Slovak summary_sk with 'AI Content · Sovereign Protocol' watermark for the pill-bottle test JPEG. /api/lens/models returns 4 entries (gpt/claude/gemini/consensus) with default='gpt'. /api/lens/analyze with invalid model → 400. /api/lens/analyze-consensus returns agreement_pct (int 0-100), kind_votes dict, per_model {gpt,claude,gemini}, watermarked merged summary. /api/lens/{scan_id}/to-jarvis → 200 with jarvis.reply containing watermark; unknown scan → 404. Compass bearing at (48.15, 17.10) returns gps + nearest_safe_city + safe_cities[≤5] + beacons + waitlist_proximity, with distance_km/bearing_deg floats and Slovak compass directions {S,SV,V,JV,J,JZ,Z,SZ}. Invalid lat=200 → 400. Cognitive Triage full lifecycle validated: state (calm/dismissed) → trigger (crisis+manual+auto_open_hud+5 SK steps+'ručne aktivované') → state remains crisis → dismiss (cooldown_until ~+15min) → state (source='dismissed', calm) → voice ingest (0.9 accepted, 1.5 and -0.1 → 400). Instructions endpoint returns 5 steps for sk/cs/en with distinct language content (Sadnite/Posaďte/Sit down) and watermarked header. Regressions all green: agent/chat watermark, briefing edge cache (2nd call faster & identical text), geo/context 16 supported cities, bioscan/measure returns 200 for sentinel smoketest-user-1.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/lens.py:172-174 asyncio.gather uses return_exceptions=False — if any single _run_vision raised (it currently doesn't because it catches), the whole consensus endpoint would 500. _run_vision already returns error dicts so this is safe today; consider return_exceptions=True defensively if _run_vision ever raises.

routes/triage.py:105 SURVIVAL_INSTRUCTIONS.get(lang, ...['sk']) — the manual trigger path never watermarks the header/instructions; only /triage/instructions endpoint watermarks the header. Not a bug per spec, but worth noting for consistency.
routes/compass.py:113 nearest_safe_city may be null only when CITIES is empty; consider a fallback message. Non-blocking.
